explanation: Arhangel'skii (BASM 2013), Problem 16: 'Is the cardinality of every homogeneous ω-monolithic compact space X not greater than 2^ω?', where ω-monolithic means 'the closure of any countable subset of X is metrizable', exactly CountablyMonolithicSpace. The formal conclusion #X ≤ 𝔠 for compact T2 homogeneous ω-monolithic X : Type. (The name says 'lt' but the statement is ≤, as in the source.) Faithful.
